title: PrimeBlocks.net Server
description: PrimeBlocks is a high-quality economic CityBuild server that has been in development for over three years. Experience a unique blend of economics, community, and custom features designed for a long-term gaming experience.
body:
# **🏙️ PrimeBlocks - Next-Generation Economic CityBuild**

PrimeBlocks is a high-quality economic CityBuild server where every player owns their own **protected plot** and becomes part of an active, player-driven economy.

## **🌍 Endless Resources & Fair Conditions**
Multiple **farm worlds** ensure that resources never run out—they are **reset monthly** so that all players have equal opportunities at all times.

## **💼 Extensive Job System**
Over **12 jobs**, such as lumberjack, miner, botanist, explorer, or hunter, await you.  
All jobs are **leveled up simultaneously**—with:
* Milestones
* Daily Quests
* Rewards & currency system

## **💰 Player-driven economy**
* Create your own **chest shops**
* Trade safely thanks to a **scam-proof trading system**
* Active trading between players

## **🎁 Endless content & features**
* Rare **collectible items**
* **Monthly events** & major community campaigns
* **Bosses & custom mobs** in the farming worlds
* Our own **End Update**, developed with the community

## **⚙️ Technology & Innovation**
* **Wi-Fi funnels & sorting systems**
* Huge **automated storage systems**
* Hundreds of **custom items & recipes**

## **🎮 Free2Play & Progress**
Even without spending real money, you can **earn premium currencies** and fully participate in the game’s progression.

## **👥 Clans & Major Events**
* **Clan system** with levels & its own shop
* Epic **dragon boss battles** with hundreds of players

## **❤️ Community & Quality**
PrimeBlocks is constantly being developed by a passionate team in collaboration with the community.  
The focus is on **quality, fairness, and long-term gaming fun**.
